verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an AI inference and training platform, but the evidence pack has no documentation of retention settings, zero-retention options, or deletion of prompts, files, or fine-tuning data. The only on-topic item is a community criticism of the privacy policy's broad data collection, which shows no user-facing control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
